description.p: Kartend is a KDE-friendly Qt frontend for organizing, browsing, and launching multimedia collections with custom launchers.

It supports large libraries through virtual scrolling, asynchronous artwork loading, collection hierarchies, persistent sessions, keyboard navigation, metadata sidebars, and configurable launch commands for media, emulators, RetroArch cores, or native applications.

Pure decision logic for five managers (detail page, selection restore, attract, overlay, gamepad) extracted into helper namespaces with 102 new unit tests covering edge cases, hysteresis, boundary fallbacks, and priority ladders.

Packaging and build polish: all CMake options namespaced to KARTEND_*, portable-release flag set for distros, gamepad/SDL2/zstd auto-detect toggles, an uninstall target, CPack tarballs, a tag-triggered release workflow with sha256 publishing, hardening flags split from performance flags, and Qt 6.4 as the new minimum.

Reliability fixes: PlaylistManager export now uses QSaveFile + parent-dir fsync, failed SQL in QueryManager rescan and DbMigrations user-version writes now log instead of failing silently, PGO instrumentation actually reaches the compiler, and several Qt 6.4 portability fixes restore builds on Ubuntu 24.04.

Substantial feature release: per-collection multi-launchers with chooser dialog, splash screens with placeholder artwork, expand mode with two-stage activation, regex title-exclusion, sortable date/file size, and a configurable items-page toolbar.

Adds the Coverflow 3D view, horizontal scrolling layout, video previews and a Now Playing overlay, per-item metadata with custom fields, an artwork gallery, chronological launch history, per-item usage stats, attract mode, alias-parent links, playlists with M3U/JSON import/export, and a runtime text zoom HUD.
Packaging adds Arch PKGBUILD and a Flatpak manifest. Tests gain an integration harness for UI-coordinator managers.
Adds the attract-mode settings UI (enable toggle, idle timeout, scroll speed) and reworks the timeout reset to react to selection changes.

Settings dialog polish, expanded build-script docs, and a fix for the shutdown crash where widget-pool callbacks could outlive their targets. Adds DatabaseManager lifecycle and path-resolution unit tests.

Large refactor splitting the largest managers (Scroll, Query, Settings, Navigation, Interaction, Viewport, ItemWidget, MainWindow, SettingsDialog) into focused sibling translation units. Fixes a UBSan shutdown vptr violation and a missing include that broke the build on Ubuntu 24.04 libstdc++.

Initial release. Virtual scrolling with widget pooling, async artwork loading with disk cache, collection hierarchy with subcollection navigation, session persistence, configurable launchers, full keyboard navigation, glide scroll animations, grid and list view modes, metadata sidebar, FTS5 search, gamepad support, and Gentoo ebuild packaging.
